correctness.rationale: Beatty complementarity yields r(n)=K(n)-s(n) exactly. At N=v(t), exact floor bounds give K(N)=K(N-1)=t-1. Any upper-plus-upper representation of N or N-1 must have index sum t, and the carry in floor(j phi^2)+floor((t-j) phi^2) is determined by the ordering of the two fractional parts. This proves the two rank formulas for every t. The packaged checker independently reconstructs the finite cases through t=1000 using exact integer floors.
